Yoga Flow Music | Santoor | 1.5 Hours

Roll out the mat. No rush, no counting - just move with the music.

Gentle santoor music for morning yoga and slow stretching: bright, open phrases that keep a soft forward pulse so your body has something to move with, without ever feeling hurried. 1.5 hours of Raga Deshkar over a steady tanpura drone.

▶ Keep going - the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN
